resources.string: Watching for the apps you chose
Mr Blocky has gone off duty
Tap to put him back on.
Turn Mr Blocky on or off
Let him see which app you have opened. Find Mr Blocky in the list and turn it on.
Let him appear on top of other apps.
If a switch is greyed out or Android says it is a restricted setting: open App info, tap the three dots in the corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
The phone has been stopping him
Some phones close apps that run in the background, to save battery. Allow this and he will be left alone.
He cannot start until the two settings below are switched on.
He is on a break, so the apps on his list will open.
He has not noticed any app being opened yet.
Apps he has noticed being opened:
the phone was short of memory
the phone decided the app was using too much power
the app was closed or force-stopped
the phone shut the app down
one of its permissions was changed
in the part that draws him, %1$s
Usage access %1$s, display over other apps %2$s, notifications %3$s, battery limits %4$s.
The phone is set to restrict this app in the background. He cannot stay on duty until that is changed, under Battery in the app\'s settings.
